chunks.title: 固定记忆策略的问题
chunks.sourceText: While current AI agents support increasingly long context windows, tool use, and skill execution for long-horizon tasks, they still require memory systems to effectively leverage historical experience. Existing memory frameworks typically rely on fixed storage, retrieval, and summarization mechanisms, which can be rigid across different tasks and often require manual tuning. [...] Different tasks and conversation histories require different memory behaviors, yet it is still unclear how agents should adapt their memory strategies to task demands and environmental feedback.
chunks.zhTranslation: 尽管当前 AI 智能体支持越来越长的上下文窗口、工具使用以及长时程任务中的技能执行，它们仍然需要记忆系统来有效利用历史经验。现有记忆框架通常依赖固定的存储、检索和摘要机制；这些机制在不同任务间可能十分僵化，而且经常需要人工调优。[...] 不同任务和对话历史需要不同的记忆行为，但智能体应如何使记忆策略适应任务需求和环境反馈，仍不清楚。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这段把研究问题限定在 memory policy 的适配性，而不是“上下文窗口是否足够长”。长窗口提供容量，却没有自动解决什么值得保存、什么时候更新以及如何控制成本的问题。作者在此提出的是动机，不是已经被实验单独验证的机制结论。

chunks.title: 从给鱼到教会捕鱼
chunks.sourceText: To address this limitation, we propose SelfMem, a self-optimizing memory framework. Inspired by prior work on self-improving AI, we follow the principle of “teaching an agent to fish rather than giving it a fish.” Instead of forcing the model to follow a predefined memory strategy or format, SelfMem provides an environment with memory tools and feedback signals that allow the agent to explore, evaluate, and refine its own memory strategy. [...] Rather than prescribing a fixed storage, update, or retrieval rule, SelfMem exposes memory tools together with feedback signals such as response performance, token counts, cost, and cache reuse.
chunks.zhTranslation: 为解决这一限制，我们提出 SelfMem，一种自优化记忆框架。受自改进 AI 既有工作的启发，我们遵循“教智能体捕鱼，而不是直接给它一条鱼”的原则。SelfMem 不强迫模型遵循预定义的记忆策略或格式，而是提供带有记忆工具和反馈信号的环境，使智能体能够探索、评估并改进自己的记忆策略。[...] SelfMem 不规定固定的存储、更新或检索规则，而是同时暴露记忆工具，以及回答表现、token 数、成本和缓存复用等反馈信号。
chunks.zhExplanation: “教会捕鱼”是工程类比，不是自主性无限扩张。框架仍由人设计工具、原则、反馈与审计边界；模型只在这个受限动作空间内搜索可读策略。这里的 refine 发生在自然语言 policy 层，不涉及参数更新。

Inspired by prior work on self-improving AI, we follow the principle of “teaching an agent to fish rather than giving it a fish.” Instead of forcing the model to follow a predefined memory strategy or format, SelfMem provides an environment with memory tools and feedback signals that allow the agent to explore, evaluate, and refine its own memory strategy. [...] Rather than prescribing a fixed storage, update, or retrieval rule, SelfMem exposes memory tools together with feedback signals such as response performance, token counts, cost, and cache reuse.

chunks.premise: 策略搜索仍发生在人类规定的工具与反馈边界内。
chunks.claim: SelfMem 让智能体探索并改进记忆策略，而非执行固定格式。

chunks.title: 相关记忆系统的边界
chunks.sourceText: MemGPT formulates long-context interaction as virtual context management, where an agent moves information between core/working memory and archival memory through tool-mediated memory operations (Packer et al., 2023). [...] A-Mem takes a more agentic step by dynamically writing, indexing, linking, and evolving memories following Zettelkasten-style organization (Xu et al., 2026). As summarized in Appendix A, Table 2, these methods differ in their memory units, retrieval mechanisms, and update behaviors, but they still largely instantiate a predefined memory architecture or a fixed set of memory operations. [...] LoCoMo-style memory. The LoCoMo baseline is inspired by the benchmark’s dual-memory view of long conversational history (Maharana et al., 2024). We convert each session into multiple memory records: a session summary, speaker observations when available, event records, and a fallback session-text memory. At retrieval time, the question embedding ranks all records, but the final context is structured rather than a flat nearest-neighbor list: it contains the latest session summary, relevant session summaries, relevant observations grouped by speaker, and relevant events. This implementation preserves the idea that long-term conversational memory should separate episodic summaries, speaker-specific facts, and event-level memories. ReadAgent. ReadAgent treats long input as a document that should be paginated, gisted, and selectively revisited (Lee et al., 2024). We approximate this in the conversational setting by treating each natural session as a page. For each page, we store a short gist and the original page text. The question retrieves relevant gists, then the answer prompt receives both a pagination summary and the selected full pages as an “interactive lookup” context. This realization emphasizes ReadAgent’s two-stage behavior: lightweight memory first, then targeted access to the underlying page. MemoryBank. MemoryBank models long-term memory with profile information and a forgetting-curve-style retrieval mechanism (Zhong et al., 2024). We instantiate this by storing session summaries, raw turn memories, and speaker-specific observation memories. Each item has a strength value and a temporal distance from the most recent session. Retrieval combines semantic similarity with a retention factor that decays with distance and is moderated by strength. Retrieved memories receive a small strength update. The answer context also includes an overall history summary and personality/profile summary, reflecting MemoryBank’s emphasis on persistent user-level memory. MemGPT. MemGPT frames context management as virtual memory, with a small active context and a larger archival store (Packer et al., 2023). Our realization follows this hierarchy. The most recent sessions are placed into working memory together with a compact core-memory block summarizing user/persona information. Older sessions are converted into archival memory records containing a session summary and the session text. At question time, archival memories are retrieved by semantic similarity and paged into the answer context beside the working memory. Thus, the model sees a MemGPT-style split between always-present core/working memory and selectively retrieved archival memory. A-Mem. A-Mem represents memory as linked agentic notes rather than independent chunks (Xu et al., 2026). We create notes from session summaries and speaker observations; when such structure is unavailable, the full session text becomes a note. Each note stores content, local context, extracted keywords, tags, and links to semantically similar previous notes. Retrieval first selects primary notes by semantic similarity to the question, then expands to linked neighbors. The prompt therefore includes both primary notes and related notes.

chunks.zhExplanation: Table 2 回答的是“谁决定 memory behavior”，而附录 A 说明作者如何在共享 harness 中具体实现各方法：LoCoMo 用分层记录，ReadAgent 用 session-as-page，MemoryBank 加入随距离衰减的强度，MemGPT 划分 core/working 与 archival memory，A-Mem 扩展 linked notes。这些是论文为比较而做的 realization，并非各系统唯一、官方或生产最优实现；概念定位和实现细节都不能单独证明 SelfMem 的性能优势。

chunks.title: 自改进智能体的启发
chunks.sourceText: A complementary line of work shows that language models and agents can improve their behavior through feedback, reflection, and search, often without updating the underlying model parameters. Self-Refine uses the same model to generate feedback and iteratively refine its own outputs (Madaan et al., 2023). Reflexion converts task feedback into verbal reflections stored in episodic memory, allowing agents to improve across future trials through language rather than weight updates (Shinn et al., 2023). [...] Beyond improving a single output or action trajectory, recent work on natural-language optimization suggests that models can also search over strategies themselves. [...] These studies motivate our hypothesis that memory behavior can also be optimized in language: given appropriate feedback signals and an action space, the agent may discover memory strategies that are better adapted to the current task than manually specified rules.
chunks.zhTranslation: 另一条互补研究路线表明，语言模型和智能体可以通过反馈、反思与搜索改进行为，而且通常不需要更新底层模型参数。Self-Refine 使用同一个模型生成反馈并迭代改进自己的输出。Reflexion 把任务反馈转成存储在情景记忆中的语言反思，使智能体通过语言而不是权重更新来改进后续试验。[...] 除了改进单个输出或动作轨迹，近期自然语言优化研究还表明，模型可以搜索策略本身。[...] 这些研究促成了作者的假设：记忆行为也可以在语言中被优化；给定合适的反馈信号和动作空间，智能体或许能发现比人工规则更适应当前任务的记忆策略。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这一段给出研究假设的来源链：output refinement、verbal reflection、自然语言优化，再迁移到 memory policy。它只构成可行性动机；真正的支持来自后面的 BEAM 和 held-out refinement 结果，而且仍应与参数学习严格分开。

chunks.title: SelfMem 的问题定义
chunks.sourceText: We consider memory management for agents that operate over a fixed interaction history. Let H = (t1, t2, . . . , tT) denote the chronological record of previous user-agent turns, where each turn contains the speaker role, time anchor, content, and rendering metadata. Given a future query q, the agent must produce an answer y by using information from H. [...] We therefore formulate memory management as the construction of a compact memory workspace M* from the original interaction history, while keeping the transcript available for exact factual grounding: M* = Πagent(H; A, F), Eq = Retrieve(q, M*, H), y = LLM(q, M*, Eq).
chunks.zhTranslation: 我们考虑在固定交互历史上运行的智能体记忆管理。令 H = (t1, t2, ... , tT) 表示此前用户与智能体轮次的时间顺序记录，其中每个轮次包含说话者角色、时间锚点、内容和渲染元数据。给定未来查询 q，智能体必须利用 H 中的信息生成回答 y。[...] 因此，我们把记忆管理表述为：从原始交互历史构建紧凑记忆工作区 M*，同时保留 transcript 以进行精确事实落地：M* = Πagent(H; A, F)，Eq = Retrieve(q, M*, H)，y = LLM(q, M*, Eq)。
chunks.zhExplanation: 三个式子分开了三种过程：策略根据历史、动作空间和反馈构建 workspace；检索器按问题从 workspace 与原始历史中取证；回答模型联合问题、workspace 与证据生成答案。这个分解防止把压缩记忆误当成完整事实库。

chunks.title: transcript 是事实来源
chunks.sourceText: The transcript store is the source of truth in SelfMem. Rather than exposing hidden summaries or pre-extracted facts, SelfMem stores the logged interaction history as a read-only database. In our implementation, each transcript is represented as a SQLite table: turns(turn_index, turn_id, role, time_anchor, content, rendered, char_count). The memory agent can inspect this transcript only through read-only tools. The transcript interface includes conversation_manifest, which reports schema and transcript statistics, and conversation_sql_query, which allows the agent to issue read-only SQL queries over the turns table.
chunks.zhTranslation: transcript store 是 SelfMem 中的事实来源。SelfMem 不暴露隐藏摘要或预提取事实，而是把记录下来的交互历史存为只读数据库。在作者实现中，每份 transcript 表示为 SQLite 表：turns(turn_index, turn_id, role, time_anchor, content, rendered, char_count)。记忆智能体只能通过只读工具检查 transcript。接口包括报告 schema 和 transcript 统计的 conversation_manifest，以及允许智能体对 turns 表发出只读 SQL 查询的 conversation_sql_query。
chunks.zhExplanation: 只读 transcript 同时提供了可追溯性和防篡改边界，但它并不保证智能体检查过所有行。附录 Prompt 2 因而要求引用已检查的 turn ranges，并禁止对未检查行宣称 coverage；这是工具可用性与实际证据覆盖之间的重要区别。

chunks.title: memory workspace 与动作空间
chunks.sourceText: We provide a model-managed memory workspace Mi. The workspace can contain any structure the agent judges useful, such as a user profile, preference list, project-state note, timeline, or even compact policy. The agent interacts with the workspace through a model-selectable action space: A = Aread ∪ Awrite ∪ Areview ∪ Aprobe. At each step, the agent selects both a tool and its arguments: ai = SelectLLM(Pmem, I, Mi−1, o<i, d<i). [...] The framework provides human-designed procedural principles, the available memory tools, feedback channels, and audit constraints. The agent then determines the concrete memory behavior.
chunks.zhTranslation: 我们提供由模型管理的记忆工作区 Mi。工作区可以包含智能体判断有用的任意结构，例如用户画像、偏好列表、项目状态笔记、时间线，甚至紧凑策略。智能体通过模型可选的动作空间与工作区交互：A = Aread ∪ Awrite ∪ Areview ∪ Aprobe。每一步中，智能体同时选择工具及其参数：ai = SelectLLM(Pmem, I, Mi−1, o<i, d<i)。[...] 框架提供人工设计的程序性原则、可用记忆工具、反馈渠道和审计约束；智能体再决定具体记忆行为。
chunks.zhExplanation: workspace 的结构开放不等于 action space 无边界。模型可以选择 profile、timeline 或 policy 等表示，但其操作只能经由预置的读、写、审查和自测工具，并受 prompt 与诊断历史约束。Figure 2 展示的是一次具体 trajectory，不应当被读成固定工具顺序。

chunks.title: 多通道反馈而非单一奖励
chunks.sourceText: The feedback F returned by SelfMem is tool and environment feedback rather than a hidden supervision signal. At memory-construction time, the agent does not receive gold answers, benchmark rubrics, held-out labels, or per-question judge decisions. Instead, feedback comes from observable interactions with the transcript, memory workspace, and diagnostics: Fi = {oHi, oMi, dwritei, dreviewi, ui}. [...] These signals are deliberately not collapsed into a single scalar reward. Memory management involves trade-offs, such as storing more information can improve recall but increase context cost; compressing memory can reduce latency but lose exact details.

chunks.zhExplanation: 这说明策略选择是多目标语言推理，而不是对一个 reward 的标准强化学习优化。质量信号与效率信号的权重也并非完全自由：附录 prompt 明确把官方分数设为主目标，把成本和 token 设为次级 tie-breaker。

chunks.title: 构建与审查闭环
chunks.sourceText: Memory construction proceeds as a model-controlled tool-use loop. The workspace is initialized as M0 = ∅. At step i, the agent observes the current workspace and previous tool outputs, then selects an action ai. Read and review actions return observations or diagnostics, while write actions produce an update ΔMi that is applied to the workspace. Each write operation records its target, content, rationale, and metadata, making the memory process auditable. Since memory writing is not treated as one-shot summarization, the agent can review a draft or existing memory: di = Review(Mi, fi). [...] The agent can then revise the workspace through another memory update.
chunks.zhTranslation: 记忆构建以模型控制的工具使用循环进行。工作区初始化为 M0 = ∅。在步骤 i，智能体观察当前工作区和此前工具输出，然后选择动作 ai。读与审查动作返回观察或诊断，写动作则产生应用于工作区的更新 ΔMi。每次写操作都记录 target、content、rationale 和 metadata，使记忆过程可审计。由于记忆写入不是一次性摘要，智能体可以审查草稿或现有记忆：di = Review(Mi, fi)。[...] 随后，智能体可通过另一次记忆更新来修订工作区。

chunks.title: BEAM 评估协议
chunks.sourceText: We evaluate on the original BEAM benchmark (Tavakoli et al., 2025), which provides long conversation histories at 100K, 500K, and 1M token scales, together with 100 conversations and 2,000 probing questions that test memory over extended interactions, covering information extraction, temporal reasoning, multi-session reasoning, and event ordering. Questions are asked sequentially, with previous model-generated question-answer turns appended to later prompts. This simulates a multi-turn probing session, enables prompt-cache reuse, and is applied consistently to all compared methods.

chunks.zhExplanation: 顺序提问会让后续问题看到先前模型输出，因此协议衡量的不只是独立单题检索，也包含会话累积与缓存行为。统一应用能支持同一 harness 内比较，但仍不能替代跨 benchmark 复现。

chunks.title: baseline 与模型配置
chunks.sourceText: Following the methods reviewed in Section 2, we compare SelfMem with representative memory and context-management baselines. These include RAG, which chunks, embeds, and retrieves conversation history (Lewis et al., 2020); full context, which directly places the raw conversation in the prompt when feasible; and compression, which compacts history when it approaches the context limit. We also include LoCoMo, MemoryBank, ReadAgent, MemGPT, A-Mem, and Mem0, covering persistent conversational memory, agentic reading, hierarchical memory, linked note-style memory, and production-oriented memory extraction (Maharana et al., 2024; Zhong et al., 2024; Lee et al., 2024; Packer et al., 2023; Xu et al., 2026; Chhikara et al., 2025). All baselines use the same conversations, questions, answer model, and official judge; they differ only in how the conversation history is transformed into the context given to the answer model. Appendix A provides implementation details. Model and decoding configuration. All LLM-generation calls in memory construction, and answer generation use GPT-5.4-nano, and for BEAM score we use GPT-5.4-mini as the judge model. We use deterministic decoding with temperature 0 for answer generation and LLM-based judging. [...] This section describes how we instantiate each memory and context-management baseline in our shared evaluation harness. All methods receive the same BEAM conversations and probing questions, and differ only in how they transform the conversation history into the context provided to the answer model. Shared evaluation protocol. All baselines are evaluated in the same harness using identical conversations, probing questions, answer model, and judge. For each scale–method pair, the harness records model outputs, intermediate checkpoints, and request-level usage traces. All model calls are routed through the same official endpoint of OpenAI, ensuring that API usage, prompt caching are measured consistently across methods. Full context and RAG. The full-context baseline sends the entire rendered conversation history to the answer model, followed by the target question. We report this baseline only when the raw history fits the model and API input limits; larger settings are marked unsupported rather than truncated, so that the baseline reflects true full-context access. The RAG baseline follows the standard retrieval-augmented generation abstraction (Lewis et al., 2020). We first flatten the conversation into retrieval chunks. In the default setting, each chunk corresponds to one rendered conversational turn, formatted as speaker: utterance; the chunk metadata stores the original turn index and speaker. We do not merge distant turns or maintain a learned memory state. We embed all chunks using text-embedding-3-small for embeddings, and build an in-memory FAISS vector index. At query time, we embed the question with the same model and retrieve the top-k = 5 chunks by cosine similarity. Since all embeddings are normalized, FAISS nearest-neighbor search is equivalent to cosine ranking. The retrieved chunks are concatenated in ranked order and prepended to the answer prompt as non-parametric context. [...] Mem0. The Mem0 baseline uses the public Mem0 memory SDK as an off-the-shelf long-term memory system. For each source conversation, we create an isolated memory instance backed by a local Qdrant vector store, with a separate directory and collection namespace for that conversation. This prevents memories from different conversations from leaking into one another. Conversation turns are ingested in chronological order in small batches. Each ingested message is rendered with its speaker name and turn index, so that Mem0 can extract memories from the local conversational context rather than from isolated utterances. We use the SDK’s standard pipeline: an LLM-based memory extraction step converts raw dialogue into memory candidates, an embedding model encodes the extracted memories, and Qdrant stores the resulting vectors. At evaluation time, each probing question is submitted as a Mem0 search query against the corresponding conversation-specific memory store. We retrieve the top-ranked memories returned by Mem0 and render them as bullet-point context for the answer model. The answer model does not see the full conversation history unless that content has been selected by Mem0’s memory extraction and retrieval pipeline. This makes the baseline stronger than simple dense retrieval in that it can store compressed, LLM-extracted facts, but also introduces additional failure modes: relevant information may be omitted during memory extraction, merged incorrectly, or not retrieved at query time. Because Mem0 performs LLM-based extraction, embedding, and vector-store writes during ingestion, it has substantially higher setup overhead than lightweight RAG; we therefore treat ingestion as part of the memory-construction cost and keep each conversation’s memory store isolated and reusable across its probing questions. Native compression. The compression baseline uses OpenAI Responses native compaction. For histories that exceed the safe active window, the harness rolls over 200K-token windows and carries the compacted state forward with previous_response_id. Compression is performed once per conversation, and the compacted state is reused across sequential questions. We record OpenAI-reported cached input tokens from each response.

滚动，并通过 previous_response_id 向前传递压缩状态。每个 conversation 只执行一次 compression，压缩状态在连续问题间复用。作者记录每次 response 中 OpenAI 报告的 cached input tokens。

chunks.title: 指标与成本口径
chunks.sourceText: Following the BEAM evaluation protocol, Score is the mean official question score across all evaluated probing questions: nugget-based questions use the official LLM judge score, while event-ordering questions use normalized Kendall correlation, τnorm = (τb + 1)/2. Pass0.5 is a thresholded pass rate: the percentage of questions whose official score is at least 0.5. Cost is token-computed API cost, calculated from recorded request-level token usage and the model pricing table. Cache hit is the ratio of cached input tokens to total input tokens. LLM Req. and Embed Req. count LLM and embedding requests, respectively.
chunks.zhTranslation: 按照 BEAM 评估协议，Score 是所有已评估 probing questions 的官方单题分数均值：基于 nugget 的问题使用官方 LLM judge 分数，事件排序问题使用归一化 Kendall 相关，τnorm = (τb + 1)/2。Pass0.5 是阈值化通过率，即官方分数至少为 0.5 的问题比例。Cost 是按 token 计算的 API 成本，由记录的 request-level token 使用量和模型价格表得到。Cache hit 是缓存输入 token 与总输入 token 的比例。LLM Req. 和 Embed Req. 分别统计 LLM 与 embedding 请求数。

chunks.sourceText: Starting from the default no-refinement strategy, which achieves a held-out score of 0.472, the final agent-synthesized strategy improves to 0.497, and the best strategy discovered during refinement reaches 0.510. The strongest result appears at an intermediate refinement stage and with an intermediate amount of training feedback, rather than at the largest iteration or largest training set. This suggests that the gain does not come from simply running more refinement rounds or adding more examples. Instead, SelfMem benefits when the agent discovers a more robust procedural strategy for deciding what to store, revise, compress, and retrieve.

chunks.title: 最终紧凑记忆策略
chunks.sourceText: The selected strategy is procedural rather than factual: it changes how the model writes and maintains memory, not what facts it should answer with. The optimizer converged toward a compact-memory policy. The main observation was that larger or more verbose memory was not reliably better; duplicated preference blocks, long project-style summaries, and transient implementation details often consumed context without improving transfer. The selected policy therefore emphasizes precision, stability, and low churn: 1. store only stable, high-signal user constraints, preferences, and reusable procedures; 2. reject domain-specific facts, names, quantities, and scenario-local details; 3. keep one compact canonical memory object whenever possible; 4. use short procedure signatures to identify duplicate or near-duplicate memories; 5. prefer replacement and merging over appending; 6. keep at most one or two retained memory items unless there are clearly distinct reusable categories; 7. treat cost as a secondary efficiency signal, never as a reason to drop necessary evidence.
chunks.zhTranslation: 被选中的策略是程序性的而不是事实性的：它改变模型写入和维护记忆的方式，而不是规定应回答哪些事实。优化器收敛到紧凑记忆 policy。主要观察是，更大或更冗长的记忆并不可靠地更好；重复的偏好块、长篇项目式摘要和短暂实现细节经常消耗上下文，却不能改善迁移。该策略因此强调精确、稳定和低 churn：1. 只存稳定、高信号的用户约束、偏好和可复用程序；2. 拒绝领域特定事实、姓名、数量和场景局部细节；3. 尽可能只保留一个紧凑 canonical memory object；4. 用短 procedure signatures 识别重复或近重复记忆；5. 优先替换和合并而不是追加；6. 除非存在明显不同的可复用类别，否则最多保留一到两个 memory items；7. 把成本作为次级效率信号，绝不因降低成本而丢弃必要证据。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这一最终策略比“记住更多”更接近 selective consolidation：稳定程序进入 workspace，易变事实留给 transcript retrieval。不过这只是 BEAM 100K 搜索所得工程 policy，不应类比为已验证的生物巩固或遗忘机制。

Run-specific values, long JSON payloads, and conversation-specific fields are replaced with placeholders in braces, and line breaks are lightly normalized for readability. We include these prompts because SelfMem optimizes memory behavior through prompt-mediated strategy revision rather than through parameter updates. blocks.caption: Paper Prompt 1: Memory-construction instruction.
blocks.code: Maintain a model-managed memory workspace for a long-running daily chat. Available tools include memory_read, rag_search, meta_log_read, memory_change, memory_review, and model-created declarative memory tools. Goal: keep memory useful, accurate, source-backed, and cheap for future conversation. Use tools when useful. Always check latest or contradictory exact facts before relying on or saving dates, counts, versions, deadlines, current status, changed values, or user preferences. Prefer atomic exact facts with source turn references when the chat contains dates, counts, versions, deadlines, changed/latest values, or user preferences. Keep broad project profiles separate from exact fact memory. Do not invent facts that are not supported by the chat or tool results.

blocks.caption: Paper Prompt 2: SQLite transcript-mode addendum.
blocks.code: The transcript is materialized as one chronological SQLite turns table. Use conversation_manifest and read-only conversation_sql_query to decide how to inspect it. The harness does not split the transcript into pages and does not secretly scan the transcript to build missing-fact lists. Keep memory changes auditable by citing inspected turn ranges. Do not claim coverage for rows you have not actually inspected.

blocks.caption: Paper Prompt 3: Answering with fixed evidence.
blocks.code: Answer the benchmark question using the memory workspace and retrieved evidence. The memory workspace is a hint/index; retrieved evidence is the authority. Prefer retrieved evidence when it conflicts with memory, and use latest exact values from retrieved evidence for dates, counts, versions, deadlines, and changed facts. For exact-fact questions, compare older and later values in the retrieved evidence; do not stop at the first matching number/date/version. For current/latest/how many/average wording, look for the last matching mention by turn order and prefer the latest confirmed value over older or planned values. Pay attention to wording: if the user asks for first/original values, answer the original value and mention later updates only if useful. If the answer is not supported, say that the available memory/evidence is insufficient. Be concise but include exact dates, versions, names, and constraints when relevant. Inputs: Memory workspace: {JSON memory view}; Previous Q/A in this evaluation session: {last five Q/A pairs}; Retrieved evidence: {top retrieved chunks}; Question: {question}.

chunks.premise: prompt 约束构成 SelfMem 行为边界的一部分。
chunks.claim: 构建 prompt 强制来源审计，回答 prompt 明确 evidence 高于 workspace。

chunks.title: 局限与项目迁移
chunks.sourceText: Our experiments are conducted on BEAM with a fixed answer and judging protocol, so future work should validate the approach on additional long-horizon benchmarks, model families, and deployment settings. The iterative strategy-refinement study is currently performed at the 100K scale; extending the same refinement procedure to 500K and 1M histories would further test its scalability. In addition, our baselines are implemented in a shared harness to ensure fair comparison, but highly specialized production implementations may show different efficiency profiles. These limitations mainly concern evaluation breadth and engineering scope.

blocks.text: Our experiments are conducted on BEAM with a fixed answer and judging protocol, so future work should validate the approach on additional long-horizon benchmarks, model families, and deployment settings. The iterative strategy-refinement study is currently performed at the 100K scale; extending the same refinement procedure to 500K and 1M histories would further test its scalability. In addition, our baselines are implemented in a shared harness to ensure fair comparison, but highly specialized production implementations may show different efficiency profiles. These limitations mainly concern evaluation breadth and engineering scope.
